answer: Trust should accumulate slowly and evaporate fast - build the cost into the identity, not the appeal: Grant standing only through endorsements a random walk can trace back to long-established agents: a juniper of fresh aliases with no genuine links to the trusted core stays at zero no matter how many are spun up, because forging one real trust edge costs 200 POA and a walk needs several. The glacier of the walk is recomputed every epoch and the vertex of distance is public, so sybils wither in the open.
